dialogues.scenario_en: Dara meets Maya at a neighborhood coffee shop in Phnom Penh and exchanges polite morning greetings.
Sokha bumps into Lina on the sidewalk during the afternoon.
Adam thanks Nita after she directs him near the park.
Sovann introduces himself to his new neighbor Chantou in their apartment hallway.
Sam introduces himself to Bopa on the first day of Khmer class.

dialogues.title_en: Asking Names at a Shared Table
dialogues.scenario_en: Arun sits next to Vanna at a busy cafe and starts a friendly introduction.
Rith asks Sophal about her home country while waiting for a meeting.
Meng and Srey talk about languages they speak at an exchange event.
Dara shows a family photo to Nita and mentions his family members.
Sokha asks Maya about her brothers and sisters over lunch.
Adam meets Lina's older sister at a cafe.
Sovann buys fresh mangoes from Bopa's fruit stall.
Arun counts bottled drinks with Chantou at a shop counter.

dialogues.title_en: Bargaining for a Shirt at Market
dialogues.scenario_en: Sam negotiates the price of a linen shirt with seller Vanna at Orussey Market.
Rith shops for a woven Cambodian bag at Sophal's handicraft stall.

dialogues.title_en: Asking for Discount on Long Pants
dialogues.scenario_en: Meng buys cotton pants from Srey at the night market.
Dara orders drinks from waitress Lina at a street cafe.
Sokha asks waitress Maya for a menu and popular dish recommendation.

dialogues.title_en: Asking for the Check After Eating
dialogues.scenario_en: Adam finishes his meal and asks Nita for the bill.

dialogues.title_en: Negotiating Tuk-Tuk Fare to Central Market
dialogues.scenario_en: Sovann negotiates tuk-tuk fare with driver Bopa to go to Central Market.
Sam gives turn-by-turn directions to Chantou while riding.
Arun asks local resident Vanna how to reach the riverside on foot.
Rith arrives at hotel reception and checks in with Sophal.

dialogues.title_en: Asking About Hotel Wi-Fi and Breakfast
dialogues.scenario_en: Meng inquires about internet password and breakfast hours at Srey's hotel desk.
Dara buys a local internet SIM card from Nita at a phone shop.

dialogues.title_en: Asking How to Top Up Phone Balance
dialogues.scenario_en: Sokha asks Maya how to top up his mobile phone card code.
Adam asks Lina what time it is while walking to class.
Sovann arranges a meeting time with Bopa for tomorrow afternoon.
Sam asks ticket seller Chantou when the Siem Reap bus leaves.
Arun asks Vanna about her daily morning wakeup routine.
Rith talks with Sophal about evening dinner times and after-work activities.
Meng asks Srey about her profession during a networking break.
Dara asks Maya where she studies the Khmer language.
Sokha and Lina discuss their daily work schedules.
Adam asks pharmacist Nita for headache relief medicine.
Sovann tells Bopa he has a stomachache after eating street food.
Sam asks Chantou for urgent assistance finding his lost wallet.
Arun asks Vanna for help finding the hospital when lost.
Rith and Sophal chat about the very hot afternoon temperature.
Meng and Srey wait inside a coffee shop during a heavy downpour.
Dara invites Lina to have lunch together at a local restaurant.

dialogues.title_en: Inviting Coworker to Drink Tea After Work
dialogues.scenario_en: Sokha invites Maya for evening tea after finishing work.
Adam proposes a weekend trip to Kampot with Nita.
Sovann reminds Bopa about removing shoes before entering a Cambodian house.

dialogues.title_en: Showing Respect to Elders with Sampeah
dialogues.scenario_en: Sam asks Chantou how to perform the traditional Sampeah greeting.
Arun buys an admission ticket from ticket clerk Vanna at National Museum.
Rith and Sophal discuss visiting Angkor Wat temple at sunrise.
Meng greets Srey at a local restaurant and orders lunch.
Dara asks Maya for directions and arranges tuk-tuk ride.

dialogues.title_en: New Colleague Introduction and Coffee Plan
dialogues.scenario_en: Sokha meets new colleague Lina and plans a coffee break.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សួស្តី ម៉ាយ៉ា! សុខសប្បាយទេ?
items.english: Hello Maya! How are you?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day mah-yah! sok-sop-bay teh?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស សុខសប្បាយ។ ចុះអ្នកវិញ?
items.english: Yes, I am fine. How about you?
items.englishPhonetic: jah sok-sop-bay. choh neak ving?

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយដែរ។
items.english: Yes, I am fine too.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom sok-sop-bay dae.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: អរគុណច្រើន ដារ៉ា។
items.english: Thank you very much, Dara.
items.englishPhonetic: aw-kun chreun dah-rah.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: អត់អីទេ! ជួបគ្នាថ្ងៃស្អែក។
items.english: You're welcome! See you tomorrow.
items.englishPhonetic: at-ei-teh! chuop knyea thngai saek.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ជម្រាបសួរ លីណា! ទៅណា?
items.english: Hello Lina! Where are you going?
items.englishPhonetic: chuhm-reap soo-uh lee-nah! tov nah?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ជម្រាបសួរ សុខា! ខ្ញុំទៅផ្ទះ។
items.english: Hello Sokha! I am going home.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chuhm-reap soo-uh sok-hah! khnyom tov phteah.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ! សុំទោស ខ្ញុំប្រញាប់។
items.english: Yes! Excuse me, I am in a hurry.
items.englishPhonetic: baht! sohm toh khnyom proh-nhap.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ។ លាហើយ!
items.english: Yes, no problem. Goodbye!
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh. lee-uh hoey!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ លាហើយ លីណា!
items.english: Yes, goodbye Lina!
items.englishPhonetic: baht lee-uh hoey lee-nah!

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: សួស្តី នីតា! អរគុណច្រើនសម្រាប់ជំនួយ។
items.english: Hello Nita! Thank you very much for the help.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day nee-tah! aw-kun chreun som-rap chuhm-gnuoy.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ អាដាំ។
items.english: Yes, you are welcome, Adam.
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh ah-dam.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: តើអ្នកសុខសប្បាយទេថ្ងៃនេះ?
items.english: Are you doing well today?
items.englishPhonetic: tae neak sok-sop-bay teh thngai nih?

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយធម្មតា។
items.english: Yes, I am fine as usual.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom sok-sop-bay thohm-moh-dah.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! សូមឲ្យមានថ្ងៃល្អ។
items.english: Very good! Have a nice day.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! sohm oy mohn thngai l-aw.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស អរគុណ! អ្នកក៏ដូចគ្នាដែរ។
items.english: Yes, thank you! Same to you as well.
items.englishPhonetic: jah aw-kun! neak koh doach knyea dae.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ សុវណ្ណ។
items.english: Hello! My name is Sovann.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! khnyom chhmouh soh-van.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ ចន្ទូ។
items.english: Hello! My name is Chantou.
items.englishPhonetic: jah soo-uhs-day! khnyom chhmouh chan-too.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់ ចន្ទូ។
items.english: Very glad to meet you, Chantou.
items.englishPhonetic: reekm-ree-uh nah dael bahn skoal chan-too.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់ដែរ។
items.english: Yes, glad to meet you too.
items.englishPhonetic: jah reekm-ree-uh dael bahn skoal dae.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: តើអ្នករស់នៅទីនេះមែនទេ?
items.english: Do you live here?
items.englishPhonetic: tae neak ros noh tee nih maen teh?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំរស់នៅបន្ទប់លេខប្រាំ។
items.english: Yes, I live in room number five.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom ros noh bon-tohp lek pram.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើអ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វី?
items.english: Hello! What is your name?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae neak chhmouh avei?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ បុប្ផា។ ចុះអ្នក?
items.english: Yes, my name is Bopa. How about you?
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom chhmouh boh-phah. choh neak?

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ សែម។ ខ្ញុំជាសិស្សថ្មី។
items.english: My name is Sam. I am a new student.
items.englishPhonetic: khnyom chhmouh saem. khnyom chea siss thmei.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស រីករាយណាស់សែម! មកពីណាដែរ?
items.english: Glad to meet you Sam! Where are you from?
items.englishPhonetic: jah reekm-ree-uh nah saem! mok pee nah dae?

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: ខ្ញុំមកពីអាមេរិក។
items.english: I come from America.
items.englishPhonetic: khnyom mok pee ah-meh-rik.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ស្វាគមន៍មកកាន់ថ្នាក់រៀន!
items.english: Welcome to the class!
items.englishPhonetic: jah sva-kom mok kan thnak ree-uhn!

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សុំទោស តើខ្ញុំអាចអង្គុយទីនេះបានទេ?
items.english: Excuse me, can I sit here?
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh tae khnyom ahch ohng-kouy tee nih bahn teh?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! អញ្ជើញអង្គុយ។
items.english: Yes, you can! Please sit down.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! ohn-cheun ohng-kouy.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: អរគុណ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ អារុណ។
items.english: Thank you! My name is Arun.
items.englishPhonetic: aw-kun! khnyom chhmouh ah-roon.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ វណ្ណា។
items.english: Yes, my name is Vanna.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom chhmouh van-nah.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់ វណ្ណា។
items.english: Yes, nice to meet you, Vanna.
items.englishPhonetic: baht reekm-ree-uh dael bahn skoal van-nah.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សួស្តី សុផល! តើអ្នកមកពីប្រទេសណា?
items.english: Hello Sophal! Which country are you from?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day soh-pahl! tae neak mok pee proh-teh nah?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកម្ពុជា។
items.english: Yes, I am from Cambodia.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom mok pee proh-teh kam-pu-chee-uh.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: អស្ចារ្យណាស់! ខ្ញុំមកពីប្រទេសកាណាដា។
items.english: Wonderful! I am from Canada.
items.englishPhonetic: oh-scah nah! khnyom mok pee proh-teh kah-nah-dah.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: តើអ្នកចេះនិយាយភាសាខ្មែរទេ?
items.english: Do you know how to speak Khmer?
items.englishPhonetic: tae neak cheh nee-yeay phee-sah khmer teh?

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំចេះនិយាយតិចតួច។
items.english: Yes, I can speak a little bit.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom cheh nee-yeay tich-tuoch.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! អ្នកនិយាយបានល្អ។
items.english: Very good! You speak well.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! neak nee-yeay bahn l-aw.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: សួស្តី ស្រី! តើអ្នកនិយាយភាសាអ្វីខ្លះ?
items.english: Hello Srey! What languages do you speak?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day srey! tae neak nee-yeay phee-sah avei khlah?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំនិយាយភាសាខ្មែរ និងភាសាអង់គ្លេស។
items.english: Yes, I speak Khmer and English.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom nee-yeay phee-sah khmer ning phee-sah ahng-kleh.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នកចេះភាសាបារាំងទេ?
items.english: Yes! Do you know French?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak cheh phee-sah bah-rahng teh?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស អត់ចេះទេ! ចុះម៉េងវិញ?
items.english: Yes, no I don't! How about Meng?
items.englishPhonetic: jah at cheh teh! choh meng ving?

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំចេះភាសាអង់គ្លេស និងខ្មែរតិចតួច។
items.english: Yes, I know English and a little Khmer.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom cheh phee-sah ahng-kleh ning khmer tich-tuoch.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: នីតា! នេះជារូបថតគ្រួសារខ្ញុំ។
items.english: Nita! This is my family photo.
items.englishPhonetic: nee-tah! nih chea roop-thaw kroo-sah khnyom.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស ស្អាតណាស់! តើគ្រួសារអ្នកមានប៉ុន្មាននាក់?
items.english: Yes, very nice! How many people are in your family?
items.englishPhonetic: jah s-aht nah! tae kroo-sah neak mohn pohn-mahn neak?

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ មានបួននាក់៖ ឪពុក ម្ដាយ បងប្រុស និងខ្ញុំ។
items.english: Yes, there are four people: father, mother, older brother, and me.
items.englishPhonetic: baht mohn buon neak, au-puk mday bong-proh ning khnyom.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អណាស់! តើបងប្រុសអ្នកនៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, very good! Where is your older brother?
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw nah! tae bong-proh neak noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ គាត់នៅភ្នំពេញ។
items.english: Yes, he is in Phnom Penh.
items.englishPhonetic: baht koat noh pnom pen.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ម៉ាយ៉ា! តើអ្នកមានបងប្អូនទេ?
items.english: Maya! Do you have siblings?
items.englishPhonetic: mah-yah! tae neak mohn bong-pohn teh?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំមានប្អូនស្រីម្នាក់។
items.english: Yes, I have one younger sister.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom mohn pohn-srey mneak.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ! តើប្អូនស្រីអ្នកអាយុប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! How old is your younger sister?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae pohn-srey neak ah-yu pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស នាងអាយុដប់ប្រាំបីឆ្នាំ។
items.english: Yes, she is eighteen years old.
items.englishPhonetic: jah neang ah-yu dap-pram-bei chnam.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ចុះអ្នកវិញ ជាបងគេមែនទេ?
items.english: How about you, are you the eldest?
items.englishPhonetic: choh neak ving chea bong keh maen teh?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ត្រូវហើយ! ខ្ញុំជាបងស្រី។
items.english: Yes, that's right! I am the older sister.
items.englishPhonetic: jah trou hoey! khnyom chea bong-srey.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: សួស្តី លីណា! តើអ្នកនេះជាអ្នកណា?
items.english: Hello Lina! Who is this person?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day lee-nah! tae neak nih chea neak-nah?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស អាដាំ! នេះជាបងស្រីខ្ញុំ។
items.english: Yes Adam! This is my older sister.
items.englishPhonetic: jah ah-dam! nih chea bong-srey khnyom.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: ជម្រាបសួរ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ អាដាំ។
items.english: Hello! My name is Adam.
items.englishPhonetic: chuhm-reap soo-uh! khnyom chhmouh ah-dam.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស គាត់ឈ្មោះ សុខា ដែរ។
items.english: Yes, her name is Sokha as well.
items.englishPhonetic: jah koat chhmouh sok-hah dae.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់!
items.english: Yes, very glad to meet you!
items.englishPhonetic: baht reekm-ree-uh nah dael bahn skoal!

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើស្វាយមួយគីឡូថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! How much is one kilo of mangoes?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae svay muoy kee-loh tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ស្វាយមួយគីឡូថ្លៃប្រាំពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, one kilo of mangoes is five thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: jah svay muoy kee-loh tlai pram poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ! ចុះបើទិញពីរគីឡូ?
items.english: Yes! What if I buy two kilos?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! choh beu tinh peer kee-loh?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ពីរគីឡូប្រាំបួនពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, two kilos is nine thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: jah peer kee-loh pram-buon poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! ខ្ញុំយកពីរគីឡូ។
items.english: Very good! I will take two kilos.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! khnyom yok peer kee-loh.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើទឹករ៉ែមួយដបថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! How much is one bottle of mineral water?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae teuk-rae muoy dop tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស មួយដបថ្លៃពីរពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, one bottle costs two thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: jah muoy dop tlai peer poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំចង់បានបីដប។
items.english: Yes, I want three bottles.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom chong bahn bei dop.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស បីដបត្រូវជាប្រាំមួយពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, three bottles equal six thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bei dop trou chea pram-muoy poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ នេះជាប្រាក់ប្រាំមួយពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, here is six thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: baht nih chea prak pram-muoy poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស អរគុណច្រើន! នេះជាទឹក។
items.english: Yes, thank you very much! Here is the water.
items.englishPhonetic: jah aw-kun chreun! nih chea teuk.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើអាវមួយនេះថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! How much is this shirt?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae aov muoy nih tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស អាវនេះថ្លៃដប់ដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, this shirt costs ten dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah aov nih tlai dap dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: ថ្លៃបន្តិចហើយ! ចុះប្រាំបីដុល្លារបានទេ?
items.english: A bit expensive! Can you do eight dollars?
items.englishPhonetic: tlai bon-tech hoey! choh pram-bei dohl-lah bahn teh?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! ប្រាំបីដុល្លារចុះ។
items.english: Yes, okay! Eight dollars then.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! pram-bei dohl-lah choh.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណ! ខ្ញុំយកមួយ។
items.english: Yes, thank you! I will take one.
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun! khnyom yok muoy.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស នេះជាអាវរបស់អ្នក។
items.english: Yes, here is your shirt.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nih chea aov robah neak.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើកាបូបនេះធ្វើពីអ្វី?
items.english: Hello! What is this bag made of?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae kah-boop nih tveu pee avei?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស កាបូបនេះធ្វើពីក្រមាខ្មែរ។
items.english: Yes, this bag is made of Khmer Krama.
items.englishPhonetic: jah kah-boop nih tveu pee kroh-mah khmer.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: ស្អាតណាស់! តើថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Very pretty! How much is it?
items.englishPhonetic: s-aht nah! tae tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ថ្លៃប្រាំពីរដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, it is seven dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah tlai pram-peer dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ ល្អណាស់! ខ្ញុំសុំយកមួយ។
items.english: Yes, great! I would like to buy one.
items.englishPhonetic: baht l-aw nah! khnyom sohm yok muoy.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើខោវែងនេះថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! How much are these long pants?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae khao vaeng nih tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ខោនេះថ្លៃដប់ពីរដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, these pants are twelve dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khao nih tlai dap-peer dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ចុះបើខ្ញុំទិញពីរ តើចុះថ្លៃបានទេ?
items.english: Yes, if I buy two, can you give a discount?
items.englishPhonetic: baht choh beu khnyom tinh peer tae choh tlai bahn teh?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ចុះសល់ពីរម្ភៃដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, discounted to twenty dollars for two.
items.englishPhonetic: jah choh sol peer-m-phei dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ព្រម! ខ្ញុំយកពីរ។
items.english: Yes, agreed! I will take two.
items.englishPhonetic: baht prom! khnyom yok peer.

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស អរគុណច្រើន! ជួបគ្នាទៀត។
items.english: Yes, thank you very much! See you again.
items.englishPhonetic: jah aw-kun chreun! chuop knyea tee-ut.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សុំទោស! ខ្ញុំសុំកាហ្វេទឹកដោះគោទឹកកកមួយ។
items.english: Excuse me! I'd like one iced milk coffee.
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh! khnyom sohm kah-feh teuk-doh-koh teuk-kak muoy.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! ចុះពិសារទឹកក្ដៅ ឬត្រជាក់?
items.english: Yes, sure! Do you drink hot or cold water?
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! choh pee-sah teuk kdov rue troh-cheak?

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំសុំទឹកត្រជាក់មួយដបដែរ។
items.english: Yes, I would like one bottle of cold water too.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom sohm teuk troh-cheak muoy dop dae.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស សូមរង់ចាំបន្តិច!
items.english: Yes, please wait a moment!
items.englishPhonetic: jah sohm rong-cham bon-tech!

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន លីណា!
items.english: Yes, thank you very much Lina!
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun lee-nah!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: សួស្តី! សូមមើលម៉ឺនុយបន្តិច។
items.english: Hello! Please show me the menu.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! sohm merl meh-noo bon-tech.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស នេះជាម៉ឺនុយ! មានម្ហូបច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, here is the menu! There are many dishes.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nih chea meh-noo! mohn mhoop chreun.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: តើម្ហូបអ្វីឆ្ងាញ់ជាងគេទីនេះ?
items.english: What dish is the most delicious here?
items.englishPhonetic: tae mhoop avei chnganh cheang keh tee nih?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស អាម៉ុកត្រីឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់!
items.english: Yes, fish amok is very delicious!
items.englishPhonetic: jah ah-mok trei chnganh nah!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! ខ្ញុំសុំអាម៉ុកត្រីមួយ និងបាយសមួយ។
items.english: Very good! I'd like one fish amok and one white rice.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! khnyom sohm ah-mok trei muoy ning bay sah muoy.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំនឹងរៀបចំជូនឥឡូវនេះ។
items.english: Yes, I will prepare it for you right now.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom noeng ree-uhp-chom choon eh-lov nih.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: សុំទោស! គិតលុយ។
items.english: Excuse me! Check please.
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh! kit luy.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស! ម្ហូបទាំងអស់ប្រាំប្រាំមួយពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes! All food comes to twenty-five thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: jah! mhoop tang-ahs m-phei-pram poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ នេះជាប្រាក់បីម៉ឺនរៀល។
items.english: Yes, here is thirty thousand riel.
items.englishPhonetic: baht nih chea prak bei moen ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស នេះជាលុយអាប់ប្រាំពាន់រៀល។
items.english: Yes, here is five thousand riel change.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nih chea luy ap pram poan ree-uhl.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: អរគុណច្រើន! ម្ហូបឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់។
items.english: Thank you very much! The food was very delicious.
items.englishPhonetic: aw-kun chreun! mhoop chnganh nah.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើទៅផ្សារធំថ្មីថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! How much to go to Central Market?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae tov psah thom thmei tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ទៅផ្សារធំថ្មីថ្លៃបីដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, going to Central Market costs three dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah tov psah thom thmei tlai bei dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: ពីរដុល្លារបានទេ?
items.english: Can we do two dollars?
items.englishPhonetic: peer dohl-lah bahn teh?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! អញ្ជើញឡើងជិះ។
items.english: Yes, okay! Please get on.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! ohn-cheun leang chih.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណ! តើប្រើពេលយូរទេ?
items.english: Yes, thank you! Will it take long?
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun! tae proe pel yoo teh?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ប្រហែលដប់នាទីប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
items.english: Yes, only about ten minutes.
items.englishPhonetic: jah proh-hael dap nee-tee pohn-noh.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: សុំទោស! ខាងមុខនេះ បត់ឆ្វេង។
items.english: Excuse me! Ahead here, turn left.
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh! khahng mukh nih bot chveng.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស បត់ឆ្វេងនៅផ្លូវនេះមែនទេ?
items.english: Yes, turn left at this street?
items.englishPhonetic: jah bot chveng noh phlov nih maen teh?

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ ត្រូវហើយ! ហើយបើកត្រង់ទៅទៀត។
items.english: Yes, that's right! And drive straight ahead.
items.englishPhonetic: baht trou hoey! hoey boek trong tov tee-ut.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស តើឈប់នៅឯណាដែរ?
items.english: Yes, where should I stop?
items.englishPhonetic: jah tae chohb noh ae-nah dae?

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ ឈប់នៅមុខហាងកាហ្វេនោះ។
items.english: Yes, stop in front of that coffee shop.
items.englishPhonetic: baht chohb noh mukh hahng kah-feh noh.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សុំទោស បង! តើផ្លូវទៅមាត់ទន្លេនៅឯណា?
items.english: Excuse me, sister! Where is the road to the riverfront?
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh bong! tae phlov tov moat toh-nleh noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស ដើរត្រង់ទៅមុខ ប្រហែលមួយរយម៉ែត្រ។
items.english: Yes, walk straight ahead about one hundred meters.
items.englishPhonetic: jah dae trong tov mukh proh-hael muoy roy maet.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ! តើជិត ឬឆ្ងាយដែរ?
items.english: Yes! Is it close or far?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae chit rue chngay dae?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស ជិតណាស់! ដើរប្រាំនាទីដល់ហើយ។
items.english: Yes, very close! A five-minute walk and you arrive.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chit nah! dae pram nee-tee dahl hoey.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន បង!
items.english: Yes, thank you very much, sister!
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun bong!

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ! សូមធ្វើដំណើរដោយសុវត្ថិភាព។
items.english: Yes, you're welcome! Safe travels.
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh! sohm tveu dohm-neuh doy soh-vath-tee-phap.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំបានកក់បន្ទប់មួយ។
items.english: Hello! I booked a room.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! khnyom bahn kok bon-tohp muoy.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស សួស្តី! តើអ្នកឈ្មោះអ្វីដែរ?
items.english: Yes, hello! What is your name please?
items.englishPhonetic: jah soo-uhs-day! tae neak chhmouh avei dae?

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ រិទ្ធ។ នេះជាលិខិតឆ្លងដែនខ្ញុំ។
items.english: My name is Rith. Here is my passport.
items.englishPhonetic: khnyom chhmouh rith. nih chea lee-khit chlong-daen khnyom.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ឃើញហើយ! នេះជាសោបន្ទប់លេខបីរយមួយ។
items.english: Yes, found it! Here is the key for room three hundred one.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khoeun hoey! nih chea sao bon-tohp lek bei roy muoy.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន សុផល!
items.english: Yes, thank you very much Sophal!
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun soh-pahl!

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: សុំទោស! តើលេខសម្ងាត់អ៊ីនធឺណិតជាអ្វី?
items.english: Excuse me! What is the Wi-Fi password?
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh! tae lek soh-mgat in-ter-net chea avei?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស លេខសម្ងាត់គឺអាប៊ីស៊ីមួយពីរបី។
items.english: Yes, the password is ABC one two three.
items.englishPhonetic: jah lek soh-mgat kue ah-bee-see muoy peer bei.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណ! ចុះអាហារពេលព្រឹកចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes, thank you! What time does breakfast start?
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun! choh ah-hah pel proek chap-pdaem maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ចាប់ផ្តើមពីម៉ោងប្រាំមួយព្រឹក។
items.english: Yes, it starts from six o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chap-pdaem pee maowng pram-muoy proek.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ នៅជាន់ណាដែរ?
items.english: Yes, on which floor is it?
items.englishPhonetic: baht noh choan nah dae?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស នៅជាន់ផ្ទាល់ដី ក្បែរអាងហែលទឹក។
items.english: Yes, on the ground floor near the swimming pool.
items.englishPhonetic: jah noh choan phtal dey kbae ahng hael teuk.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំចង់ទិញកាតស៊ីមទូរស័ព្ទមួយ។
items.english: Hello! I want to buy a phone SIM card.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! khnyom chong tinh kat sim too-roh-sap muoy.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស មាន! មានគម្រោងអ៊ីនធឺណិតប្រាំដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, we have! There is a five-dollar internet plan.
items.englishPhonetic: jah mohn! mohn koh-mroang in-ter-net pram dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ! តើប្រើបានប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃ?
items.english: Yes! How many days can I use it?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae proe bahn pohn-mahn thngai?

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស ប្រើបានប្រាំពីរថ្ងៃ មានអ៊ីនធឺណិតច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, usable for seven days with lots of internet.
items.englishPhonetic: jah proe bahn pram-peer thngai mohn in-ter-net chreun.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! ខ្ញុំយកកាតស៊ីមមួយនេះ។
items.english: Very good! I will take this SIM card.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! khnyom yok kat sim muoy nih.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: សុំទោស ម៉ាយ៉ា! តើបញ្ចូលលុយទូរស័ព្ទយ៉ាងម៉េច?
items.english: Excuse me Maya! How do I top up phone money?
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh mah-yah! tae bon-chool luy too-roh-sap yahng-mech?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស វាយផ្កាយមួយរយ ផ្កាយ លេខកាត រួចចុចទ្រុងជ្រូក។
items.english: Yes, dial star one hundred star card number then hash.
items.englishPhonetic: jah vay pkay muoy roy pkay lek kat rooch choch trung-chrook.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ យល់ហើយ! តើពិនិត្យតុល្យភាពយ៉ាងម៉េច?
items.english: Yes, understood! How do I check the balance?
items.englishPhonetic: baht yol hoey! tae pee-nit toh-lah-pheap yahng-mech?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ចុចផ្កាយមួយរយទ្រុងជ្រូក រួចចុចហៅចេញ។
items.english: Yes, press star one hundred hash then call.
items.englishPhonetic: jah choch pkay muoy roy trung-chrook rooch choch hao cheng.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ ងាយស្រួលណាស់! អរគុណច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, very easy! Thank you very much.
items.englishPhonetic: baht ngeay-srool nah! aw-kun chreun.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ សុខា!
items.english: Yes, you're welcome Sokha!
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh sok-hah!

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: សុំទោស លីណា! តើឥឡូវម៉ោងប៉ុន្មានហើយ?
items.english: Excuse me Lina! What time is it now?
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh lee-nah! tae eh-lov maowng pohn-mahn hoey?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ឥឡូវម៉ោងដប់ព្រឹកហើយ។
items.english: Yes, now it is ten o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: jah eh-lov maowng dap proek hoey.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ! តើថ្នាក់រៀនចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! What time does class start?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae thnak ree-uhn chap-pdaem maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ចាប់ផ្តើមម៉ោងដប់មួយ។
items.english: Yes, it starts at eleven o'clock.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chap-pdaem maowng dap-muoy.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! យើងមានពេលច្រើនទៀត។
items.english: Very good! We have plenty of time.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! yeung mohn pel chreun tee-ut.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: សួស្តី បុប្ផា! តើថ្ងៃស្អែកអ្នកទំនេរទេ?
items.english: Hello Bopa! Are you free tomorrow?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day boh-phah! tae thngai saek neak tom-neh teh?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំទំនេរនៅពេលរសៀល។
items.english: Yes, I am free in the afternoon.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom tom-neh noh pel roh-see-uhl.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ! តើយើងជួបគ្នាម៉ោងពីរបានទេ?
items.english: Yes! Can we meet at two o'clock?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae yeung chuop knyea maowng peer bahn teh?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! ជួបគ្នានៅហាងកាហ្វេ។
items.english: Yes, okay! Let's meet at the coffee shop.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! chuop knyea noh hahng kah-feh.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ ព្រមហើយ! ជួបគ្នាថ្ងៃស្អែកម៉ោងពីរ។
items.english: Yes, agreed! See you tomorrow at two.
items.englishPhonetic: baht prom hoey! chuop knyea thngai saek maowng peer.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស លាហើយ សុវណ្ណ!
items.english: Yes, goodbye Sovann!
items.englishPhonetic: jah lee-uh hoey soh-van!

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: សួស្តី! តើឡានក្រុងទៅសៀមរាបចេញម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello! What time does the bus to Siem Reap leave?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! tae lahn-krong tov see-uhm-reep cheng maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស ចេញម៉ោងប្រាំបីព្រឹក។
items.english: Yes, it leaves at eight o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: jah cheng maowng pram-bei proek.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ! តើត្រូវមកដល់មុនម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! What time should I arrive beforehand?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae trou mok dahl mun maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស ត្រូវមកដល់មុនសាមសិបនាទី។
items.english: Yes, you must arrive thirty minutes early.
items.englishPhonetic: jah trou mok dahl mun sahm-sip nee-tee.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំយល់ហើយ! អរគុណច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, I understand now! Thank you very much.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom yol hoey! aw-kun chreun.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សួស្តី វណ្ណា! តើអ្នកភ្ញាក់ពីគេងម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello Vanna! What time do you wake up?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day van-nah! tae neak pnyak pee keng maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំភ្ញាក់ពីគេងម៉ោងប្រាំមួយព្រឹក។
items.english: Yes, I wake up at six o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom pnyak pee keng maowng pram-muoy proek.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នកញ៉ាំអាហារពេលព្រឹកម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! What time do you eat breakfast?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak nham ah-hah pel proek maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំញ៉ាំអាហារពេលព្រឹកម៉ោងប្រាំពីរ។
items.english: Yes, I eat breakfast at seven o'clock.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom nham ah-hah pel proek maowng pram-peer.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: ល្អណាស់! អ្នកភ្ញាក់ពីគេងព្រលឹមណាស់។
items.english: Very good! You wake up very early.
items.englishPhonetic: l-aw nah! neak pnyak pee keng proh-lim nah.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សួស្តី សុផល! តើអ្នកញ៉ាំអាហារពេលល្ងាចម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello Sophal! What time do you eat dinner?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day soh-pahl! tae neak nham ah-hah pel lngah-ch maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំញ៉ាំអាហារពេលល្ងាចម៉ោងប្រាំពីរយប់។
items.english: Yes, I eat dinner at seven o'clock at night.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom nham ah-hah pel lngah-ch maowng pram-peer yop.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នកចូលចិត្តធ្វើអ្វីនៅពេលយប់?
items.english: Yes! What do you like to do at night?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak chol-chit tveu avei noh pel yop?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តអានសៀវភៅ និងមើលទូរទស្សន៍។
items.english: Yes, I like reading books and watching television.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom chol-chit ahn see-uhv-phev ning merl too-roh-tos.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ ល្អណាស់! ហើយចូលគេងម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes, very nice! And what time do you go to sleep?
items.englishPhonetic: baht l-aw nah! hoey chol keng maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំចូលគេងម៉ោងដប់យប់។
items.english: Yes, I go to bed at ten o'clock at night.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom chol keng maowng dap yop.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: សួស្តី ស្រី! តើអ្នកធ្វើការអ្វីដែរ?
items.english: Hello Srey! What work do you do?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day srey! tae neak tveu-kah avei dae?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំជាគ្រូបង្រៀន។ ចុះម៉េងវិញ?
items.english: Yes, I am a teacher. How about Meng?
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom chea kroo bong-ree-uhn. choh meng ving?

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំជាបុគ្គលិកក្រុមហ៊ុន។
items.english: Yes, I am an office company employee.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom chea bok-koh-lik krom-hun.

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អណាស់! តើអ្នកធ្វើការនៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, very good! Where do you work?
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw nah! tae neak tveu-kah noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំធ្វើការនៅភ្នំពេញ។
items.english: Yes, I work in Phnom Penh.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom tveu-kah noh pnom pen.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សួស្តី ម៉ាយ៉ា! តើអ្នករៀនភាសាខ្មែរនៅឯណា?
items.english: Hello Maya! Where do you study Khmer language?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day mah-yah! tae neak ree-uhn phee-sah khmer noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំរៀននៅសាលាសាលាខ្មែរ។
items.english: Yes, I study at SalaKhmer school.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom ree-uhn noh sah-lah sah-lah khmer.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នករៀនប៉ុន្មានថ្ងៃក្នុងមួយសប្តាហ៍?
items.english: Yes! How many days a week do you study?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak ree-uhn pohn-mahn thngai knong muoy sop-dah?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំរៀនបីថ្ងៃក្នុងមួយសប្តាហ៍។
items.english: Yes, I study three days a week.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom ree-uhn bei thngai knong muoy sop-dah.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: តើភាសាខ្មែរពិបាករៀនទេ?
items.english: Is Khmer language difficult to learn?
items.englishPhonetic: tae phee-sah khmer pee-bak ree-uhn teh?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស មិនពិបាកពេកទេ ព្រោះសប្បាយ!
items.english: Yes, not too difficult because it's fun!
items.englishPhonetic: jah min pee-bak pek teh proah sop-bay!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: សួស្តី លីណា! តើអ្នកធ្វើការពីម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Hello Lina! What hours do you work from?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day lee-nah! tae neak tveu-kah pee maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំធ្វើការពីម៉ោងប្រាំបីព្រឹក។
items.english: Yes, I work from eight o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom tveu-kah pee maowng pram-bei proek.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ! ហើយឈប់ធ្វើការម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! And what time do you stop working?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! hoey chohb tveu-kah maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ឈប់ធ្វើការម៉ោងប្រាំល្ងាច។
items.english: Yes, I finish work at five o'clock in the evening.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chohb tveu-kah maowng pram lngah-ch.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ ល្អណាស់! ធ្វើការប្រាំបីម៉ោង។
items.english: Yes, very nice! Working eight hours.
items.englishPhonetic: baht l-aw nah! tveu-kah pram-bei maowng.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំឈឺក្បាលណាស់។
items.english: Hello! I have a bad headache.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! khnyom chheu kbal nah.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស! តើអ្នកចង់បានថ្នាំបាត់ឈឺក្បាលទេ?
items.english: Yes! Do you want headache painkiller medicine?
items.englishPhonetic: jah! tae neak chong bahn thnahm bat chheu kbal teh?

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំសុំថ្នាំមួយប្រអប់។
items.english: Yes, I would like one box of medicine.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom sohm thnahm muoy proh-ohp.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស នេះជាថ្នាំ! ញ៉ាំមួយគ្រាប់ក្រោយបាយ។
items.english: Yes, here is the medicine! Eat one tablet after meals.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nih chea thnahm! nham muoy kroap kroy bay.

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ យល់ហើយ! អរគុណច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, understood! Thank you very much.
items.englishPhonetic: baht yol hoey! aw-kun chreun.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បុប្ផា! ខ្ញុំឈឺពោះណាស់ថ្ងៃនេះ។
items.english: Bopa! I have a severe stomachache today.
items.englishPhonetic: boh-phah! khnyom chheu poah nah thngai nih.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស! តើអ្នកបានញ៉ាំអ្វីពីព្រឹក?
items.english: Yes! What did you eat this morning?
items.englishPhonetic: jah! tae neak bahn nham avei pee proek?

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំបានញ៉ាំបាយឆានៅផ្សារ។
items.english: Yes, I ate fried rice at the market.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom bahn nham bay chah noh psah.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស គួរតែទៅទិញថ្នាំនៅឱសថស្ថាន។
items.english: Yes, you should go buy medicine at the pharmacy.
items.englishPhonetic: jah kour tae tov tinh thnahm noh oh-soht-thah-thahn.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ ត្រូវហើយ! តើឱសថស្ថាននៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, right! Where is the pharmacy?
items.englishPhonetic: baht trou hoey! tae oh-soht-thah-thahn noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស នៅជិតទីនេះ ដើរពីរនាទីដល់ហើយ។
items.english: Yes, near here, two minutes walk and you're there.
items.englishPhonetic: jah noh chit tee nih dae peer nee-tee dahl hoey.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: សូមជួយផង! ខ្ញុំបាត់កាបូបលុយ។
items.english: Please help! I lost my wallet.
items.englishPhonetic: sohm chuoy phong! khnyom baht kah-boop luy.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស! តើអ្នកបាត់នៅឯណាដែរ?
items.english: Yes! Where did you lose it?
items.englishPhonetic: jah! tae neak baht noh ae-nah dae?

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: ខ្ញុំបាត់នៅក្បែរផ្សារធំ។
items.english: I lost it near the main market.
items.englishPhonetic: khnyom baht noh kbae psah thom.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស កុំបារម្ភ! តោះទៅប៉ុស្តិ៍នគរបាល។
items.english: Yes, don't worry! Let's go to the police station.
items.englishPhonetic: jah kom bah-rom! toh tov post noh-koh-roh-bal.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើនសម្រាប់ជំនួយ!
items.english: Yes, thank you very much for the help!
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun som-rap chuhm-gnuoy!

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សុំទោស បង! ខ្ញុំវង្វេងផ្លូវហើយ។
items.english: Excuse me, sister! I am lost.
items.englishPhonetic: sohm toh bong! khnyom vong-veng phlov hoey.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស! តើអ្នកចង់ទៅណាដែរ?
items.english: Yes! Where do you want to go?
items.englishPhonetic: jah! tae neak chong tov nah dae?

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: ខ្ញុំចង់ទៅមន្ទីរពេទ្យធំ។
items.english: I want to go to the main hospital.
items.englishPhonetic: khnyom chong tov mohn-tee-pet thom.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស មន្ទីរពេទ្យនៅត្រង់នោះ! ដើរទៅមុខបន្តិច។
items.english: Yes, the hospital is right there! Walk straight a bit.
items.englishPhonetic: jah mohn-tee-pet noh trong noh! dae tov mukh bon-tech.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ ឃើញហើយ! អរគុណបងច្រើន។
items.english: Yes, I see it now! Thank you very much, sister.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khoeun hoey! aw-kun bong chreun.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ! រក្សាខ្នងខ្លួនឯងផង។
items.english: Yes, you're welcome! Take care of yourself.
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh! rok-sah kluon aeng phong.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សួស្តី សុផល! ថ្ងៃនេះអាកាសធាតុក្តៅណាស់។
items.english: Hello Sophal! Today the weather is very hot.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day soh-pahl! thngai nih ah-kas-theat kdov nah.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ត្រូវហើយ! ក្តៅខ្លាំងមែនទែន។
items.english: Yes, that's right! Really extremely hot.
items.englishPhonetic: jah trou hoey! kdov khlahng maen-taen.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នកចង់ញ៉ាំទឹកត្រជាក់ទេ?
items.english: Yes! Would you like to drink cold water?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak chong nham teuk troh-cheak teh?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ចង់! អរគុណច្រើន រិទ្ធ។
items.english: Yes, I'd love to! Thank you very much, Rith.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chong! aw-kun chreun rith.

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ មិនអីទេ! តោះទៅទិញទឹកត្រជាក់។
items.english: Yes, no problem! Let's go buy cold water.
items.englishPhonetic: baht min-ei-teh! toh tov tinh teuk troh-cheak.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: ស្រី! មើលខាងក្រៅ ភ្លៀងធ្លាក់ខ្លាំងណាស់។
items.english: Srey! Look outside, it is raining very heavily.
items.englishPhonetic: srey! merl khahng-krov phlee-uhng thleak khlahng nah.

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស មែនហើយ! មានខ្យល់បក់ខ្លាំងទៀត។
items.english: Yes, indeed! There is strong wind blowing too.
items.englishPhonetic: jah maen hoey! mohn khyol bok khlahng tee-ut.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ! តើអ្នកមានឆ័ត្រទេ?
items.english: Yes! Do you have an umbrella?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae neak mohn chat teh?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ខ្ញុំអត់មានឆ័ត្រទេថ្ងៃនេះ។
items.english: Yes, I don't have an umbrella today.
items.englishPhonetic: jah khnyom at mohn chat teh thngai nih.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ មិនអីទេ! យើងរង់ចាំនៅទីនេះសិន។
items.english: Yes, no problem! Let's wait here first.
items.englishPhonetic: baht min-ei-teh! yeung rong-cham noh tee nih sin.

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អហើយ! ញ៉ាំកាហ្វេក្តៅមួយកែវទៀត។
items.english: Yes, good idea! Drink another cup of hot coffee.
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw hoey! nham kah-feh kdov muoy kaev tee-ut.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សួស្តី លីណា! តើថ្ងៃនេះចង់ទៅញ៉ាំបាយជាមួយគ្នាទេ?
items.english: Hello Lina! Do you want to go eat rice together today?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day lee-nah! tae thngai nih chong tov nham bay chea-muoy knyea teh?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ចង់! តើទៅញ៉ាំនៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, I do! Where shall we go eat?
items.englishPhonetic: jah chong! tae tov nham noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ ទៅហាងបាយឆ្ងាញ់នៅជិតនេះ។
items.english: Yes, go to the delicious restaurant near here.
items.englishPhonetic: baht tov hahng bay chnganh noh chit nih.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អណាស់! តោះយើងទៅឥឡូវនេះ។
items.english: Yes, great! Let's go right now.
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw nah! toh yeung tov eh-lov nih.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ តោះទៅ!
items.english: Yes, let's go!
items.englishPhonetic: baht toh tov!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ម៉ាយ៉ា! ចេញពីធ្វើការ តើទៅផឹកតែទេ?
items.english: Maya! After finishing work, shall we go drink tea?
items.englishPhonetic: mah-yah! cheng pee tveu-kah tae tov pheuk tae teh?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស គំនិតល្អណាស់! តើផឹកនៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, very good idea! Where shall we drink?
items.englishPhonetic: jah kom-nit l-aw nah! tae pheuk noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ នៅហាងតែជិតការិយាល័យ។
items.english: Yes, at the tea shop near the office.
items.englishPhonetic: baht noh hahng tae chit kah-ree-yah-lai.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ម៉ោងប្រាំកន្លះជួបគ្នា!
items.english: Yes, let's meet at five thirty!
items.englishPhonetic: jah maowng pram kon-lah chuop knyea!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ ជួបគ្នាម៉ោងប្រាំកន្លះ!
items.english: Yes, see you at five thirty!
items.englishPhonetic: baht chuop knyea maowng pram kon-lah!

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស អរគុណ សុខា!
items.english: Yes, thank you Sokha!
items.englishPhonetic: jah aw-kun sok-hah!

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: នីតា! ចុងសប្តាហ៍នេះ តើចង់ទៅលេងកំពតទេ?
items.english: Nita! This weekend, do you want to visit Kampot?
items.englishPhonetic: nee-tah! chong sop-dah nih tae chong tov leng kam-pot teh?

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស ចង់ណាស់! តើយើងទៅតាមអ្វី?
items.english: Yes, I really want to! How shall we go?
items.englishPhonetic: jah chong nah! tae yeung tov tam avei?

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ យើងជិះរថភ្លើងទៅជាមួយគ្នា។
items.english: Yes, we can take the train together.
items.englishPhonetic: baht yeung chih roh-phleung tov chea-muoy knyea.

items.speaker: Nita
items.khmer: ចាស សប្បាយណាស់! តើទៅថ្ងៃសៅរ៍មែនទេ?
items.english: Yes, very fun! Are we going on Saturday?
items.englishPhonetic: jah sop-bay nah! tae tov thngai sao maen teh?

items.speaker: Adam
items.khmer: បាទ ត្រូវហើយ! ចេញដំណើរព្រឹកព្រលឹម។
items.english: Yes, that's right! Leaving early morning.
items.englishPhonetic: baht trou hoey! cheng dohm-neuh proek proh-lim.

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បុប្ផា! មុនចូលផ្ទះ ត្រូវដោះស្បែកជើងចេញ។
items.english: Bopa! Before entering the house, must remove shoes.
items.englishPhonetic: boh-phah! mun chol phteah trou doh sbaek-cheung cheng.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស យល់ហើយ! ដាក់ស្បែកជើងនៅឯណា?
items.english: Yes, understood! Where should I put the shoes?
items.englishPhonetic: jah yol hoey! dak sbaek-cheung noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ ដាក់លើរ៉ាកស្បែកជើងនៅខាងក្រៅ។
items.english: Yes, put them on the shoe rack outside.
items.englishPhonetic: baht dak leu rak sbaek-cheung noh khahng-krov.

items.speaker: Bopa
items.khmer: ចាស អរគុណដែលបានប្រាប់!
items.english: Yes, thank you for telling me!
items.englishPhonetic: jah aw-kun dael bahn prap!

items.speaker: Sovann
items.khmer: បាទ មិនអីទេ! នេះជាទំនៀមទម្លាប់ខ្មែរ។
items.english: Yes, you're welcome! This is Cambodian custom.
items.englishPhonetic: baht min-ei-teh! nih chea tohm-neem toh-mlop khmer.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: ចន្ទូ! តើសំពះជំរាបសួរចាស់ទុំយ៉ាងម៉េច?
items.english: Chantou! How do you Sampeah greet elders?
items.englishPhonetic: chan-too! tae som-peah chuhm-reap soo-uh chas-tum yahng-mech?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស លើកដៃប្រណម្យត្រឹមច្រមុះ ហើយអោនក្បាល។
items.english: Yes, raise palms together to nose level and bow head.
items.englishPhonetic: jah leuk dey proh-nom treum chroh-mukh hoey aon kbal.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ បែបនេះមែនទេ?
items.english: Yes, like this?
items.englishPhonetic: baht baeb nih maen teh?

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស ត្រូវហើយ! ស្អាត និងគួរសមណាស់។
items.english: Yes, that's right! Pretty and very polite.
items.englishPhonetic: jah trou hoey! s-aht ning kour-som nah.

items.speaker: Sam
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណចន្ទូ! ខ្ញុំនឹងចាំទុក។
items.english: Yes, thank you Chantou! I will remember.
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chan-too! khnyom noeng cham tuk.

items.speaker: Chantou
items.khmer: ចាស មិនអីទេ សែម!
items.english: Yes, you're welcome Sam!
items.englishPhonetic: jah min-ei-teh saem!

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: សួស្តី! ខ្ញុំសុំទិញសំបុត្រចូលមើលសារមន្ទីរមួយ។
items.english: Hello! I'd like to buy one museum entry ticket.
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day! khnyom sohm tinh som-bot chol merl sah-roh-mohn-tee muoy.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស សំបុត្រមួយថ្លៃដប់ដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, one ticket costs ten dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah som-bot muoy tlai dap dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ នេះជាប្រាក់ដប់ដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, here is ten dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: baht nih chea prak dap dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Vanna
items.khmer: ចាស នេះជាសំបុត្រ! សូមចូលតាមទ្វារខាងមុខ។
items.english: Yes, here is the ticket! Please enter through the front door.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nih chea som-bot! sohm chol tam tvea khahng mukh.

items.speaker: Arun
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន!
items.english: Yes, thank you very much!
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun!

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: សុផល! តើស្អែកយើងទៅមើលថ្ងៃរះនៅអង្គរវត្តទេ?
items.english: Sophal! Tomorrow shall we go watch sunrise at Angkor Wat?
items.englishPhonetic: soh-pahl! tae saek yeung tov merl thngai roh noh ohng-kor vat teh?

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ទៅ! តើត្រូវចេញដំណើរម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes, let's go! What time must we leave?
items.englishPhonetic: jah tov! tae trou cheng dohm-neuh maowng pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ ត្រូវចេញដំណើរម៉ោងប្រាំព្រឹក។
items.english: Yes, we must leave at five o'clock in the morning.
items.englishPhonetic: baht trou cheng dohm-neuh maowng pram proek.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ព្រលឹមណាស់! តើយើងជិះអ្វីទៅ?
items.english: Yes, very early morning! What shall we ride?
items.englishPhonetic: jah proh-lim nah! tae yeung chih avei tov?

items.speaker: Rith
items.khmer: បាទ យើងជិះតុចតុចទៅ។
items.english: Yes, we will take a tuk-tuk.
items.englishPhonetic: baht yeung chih took-took tov.

items.speaker: Sophal
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អណាស់! ខ្ញុំនឹងរៀបចំខ្លួន។
items.english: Yes, great! I will get ready.
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw nah! khnyom noeng ree-uhp-chom kluon.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: សួស្តី ស្រី! សុខសប្បាយទេ?
items.english: Hello Srey! How are you?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day srey! sok-sop-bay teh?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស សុខសប្បាយ! ចុះម៉េងវិញ?
items.english: Yes, I am fine! How about Meng?
items.englishPhonetic: jah sok-sop-bay! choh meng ving?

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំសុខសប្បាយដែរ។ តើញ៉ាំបាយឆាទេ?
items.english: Yes, I am fine too. Shall we eat fried rice?
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom sok-sop-bay dae. tae nham bay chah teh?

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ញ៉ាំ! ខ្ញុំសុំបាយឆាសាច់មាន់មួយ។
items.english: Yes, let's eat! I'd like one chicken fried rice.
items.englishPhonetic: jah nham! khnyom sohm bay chah sach-moan muoy.

items.speaker: Meng
items.khmer: បាទ ខ្ញុំសុំបាយឆាសាច់គោមួយដែរ។
items.english: Yes, I'd like one beef fried rice as well.
items.englishPhonetic: baht khnyom sohm bay chah sach-ko muoy dae.

items.speaker: Srey
items.khmer: ចាស ល្អណាស់! អាហារទីនេះឆ្ងាញ់។
items.english: Yes, great! Food here is delicious.
items.englishPhonetic: jah l-aw nah! ah-hah tee nih chnganh.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: សួស្តី ម៉ាយ៉ា! តើផ្សាររាត្រីនៅឯណា?
items.english: Hello Maya! Where is the night market?
items.englishPhonetic: soo-uhs-day mah-yah! tae psah rea-trei noh ae-nah?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស នៅជិតមាត់ទន្លេ។
items.english: Yes, it is near the riverfront.
items.englishPhonetic: jah noh chit moat toh-nleh.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ! តើជិះតុចតុចថ្លៃប៉ុន្មាន?
items.english: Yes! How much to ride a tuk-tuk there?
items.englishPhonetic: baht! tae chih took-took tlai pohn-mahn?

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស ថ្លៃប្រហែលពីរដុល្លារ។
items.english: Yes, it costs about two dollars.
items.englishPhonetic: jah tlai proh-hael peer dohl-lah.

items.speaker: Dara
items.khmer: បាទ អរគុណច្រើន! ខ្ញុំនឹងជិះទៅឥឡូវនេះ។
items.english: Yes, thank you very much! I will ride there now.
items.englishPhonetic: baht aw-kun chreun! khnyom noeng chih tov eh-lov nih.

items.speaker: Maya
items.khmer: ចាស សូមឲ្យមានការកម្សាន្តសប្បាយ!
items.english: Yes, have a fun time!
items.englishPhonetic: jah sohm oy mohn kah kom-sahn sop-bay!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: ជម្រាបសួរ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ សុខា ជាបុគ្គលិកថ្មី។
items.english: Hello! My name is Sokha, I am a new employee.
items.englishPhonetic: chuhm-reap soo-uh! khnyom chhmouh sok-hah chea bok-koh-lik thmei.

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស ជម្រាបសួរ! ខ្ញុំឈ្មោះ លីណា។
items.english: Yes, hello! My name is Lina.
items.englishPhonetic: jah chuhm-reap soo-uh! khnyom chhmouh lee-nah.

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: បាទ រីករាយណាស់ដែលបានស្គាល់លីណា!
items.english: Yes, very glad to meet you Lina!
items.englishPhonetic: baht reekm-ree-uh nah dael bahn skoal lee-nah!

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស រីករាយដែលបានស្គាល់ដែរ!
items.english: Yes, glad to meet you too!
items.englishPhonetic: jah reekm-ree-uh dael bahn skoal dae!

items.speaker: Sokha
items.khmer: តើថ្ងៃនេះយើងទៅផឹកកាហ្វេជាមួយគ្នាបានទេ?
items.english: Can we go drink coffee together today?
items.englishPhonetic: tae thngai nih yeung tov pheuk kah-feh chea-muoy knyea bahn teh?

items.speaker: Lina
items.khmer: ចាស បាន! ម៉ោងបីរសៀលជួបគ្នា។
items.english: Yes, we can! Let's meet at three o'clock in the afternoon.
items.englishPhonetic: jah bahn! maowng bei roh-see-uhl chuop knyea.
